strings.templates.title: Message templates

strings.about.title: About Git Messages
strings.about.body: Git Messages is a curated reference for commit message conventions and a tool for composing clear messages.
strings.about.detail: It covers Conventional Commits and Angular-style messages, including types, emoji mappings, examples, and reusable templates.
strings.help.title: Help
strings.privacy.title: Privacy
strings.privacy.body: This service serves a static, curated commit convention catalog. It does not provide user accounts, accept user submissions, or persist personal data. Operational logs may be handled by the server operator.
strings.terms.title: Terms
strings.terms.body: The catalog is provided as a reference. Check the selected convention and your repository's contribution rules before using a generated message.
strings.health.title: Service health
strings.api.encode_failed: The response could not be encoded
strings.api.invalid_request: Request must contain a valid commit message description
strings.api.invalid_json: Request must contain exactly one JSON object
strings.graphql.title: GraphQL
strings.graphql.description: Query the public commit catalog. The form works without JavaScript; the script only improves the response display.
strings.graphql.result: Submit the query to view its response.
strings.common.offline_body: This page is not available offline.
strings.cli.server_required: Set --server or GITMESSAGES_SERVER_PRIMARY to an http(s) server URL
strings.cli.random: Print a random example commit message
strings.cli.server_source: The server URL comes from --server, GITMESSAGES_SERVER_PRIMARY, or cli.yml.
strings.catalog.type.style: Formatting or style changes without behavior changes
strings.catalog.type.refactor: Code changes that neither fix a bug nor add a feature
strings.catalog.type.chore: Maintenance work that does not change application behavior
strings.catalog.type.build: Changes to build tools or dependencies
strings.catalog.convention.conventional-commits: Structured commit messages with a type, optional scope, and concise description.
strings.catalog.convention.angular: Angular-style commit messages using the same recognized types and optional scopes.
